long_biography.plain_text:
Ten Brinke entered Bribus at nineteen, when the family kitchen manufacturer was still being led by his father. His father's illness accelerated the succession and placed the third generation in charge. He professionalised production, invested in automation and sharpened the company's focus on large property-sector customers. That expansion prepared Bribus for its 2018 sale to European kitchen group Nobia.

After the sale, Ten Brinke built BTB Group around investments, property, industrial businesses and specialist cars. Motorsport remains a parallel defining pursuit, separate from the businesses that established his financial position. He progressed from circuit racing to international rallying and repeatedly contested the Dakar. In 2018, he became the first Dutch car driver to win a Dakar stage. He continues to compete while allocating capital through privately held businesses.
